CDC HEADS UP Return-to-Activity Stages:
- Stage 1 (days 1-2, score 7-10): Complete rest. No screens, no exercise, no school.
- Stage 2 (days 3-5, score 4-6): Light aerobic only. Walking 20-30 min. Stop if symptoms appear.
- Stage 3 (days 6-8, score 2-4): Sport-specific exercise. No contact. Screen time 2 hrs max.
- Stage 4 (days 9-12, score 0-2): Non-contact drills. Full school. Medical clearance for Stage 5.
- Stage 5 (day 13+, score 0): Full return with medical clearance.

Determine the appropriate stage and generate a personalized daily recommendation. Output JSON with these exact fields: activity_level (rest/light/moderate/full), activity_label (e.g. Stage 2 - Light Aerobic), recommendation (2-3 sentences specific to today), protocol_stage (number 1-5), protocol_source (CDC HEADS UP Return-to-Activity), next_step (what to do tomorrow), encouragement (one uplifting sentence).

parameters.toolDescription: Retrieve CDC HEADS UP and Buffalo Protocol return-to-activity guidelines.
